scope: Restore verified narrow two-column text with compatible unembedded Roman fallback, explicit Word column frames and one left-to-right column transition. Incremental fidelity improvement; not production readiness.
publication_status: Local qualification complete for runtime source; final evidence freeze and exact publication-head CI tracked separately.

behavior.gutter: At least 4 supporting rows share one central whitespace band; minimum adjacent font-size ratio and broad text on both sides. Reject crossing text, invalid geometry and multiple sustained disjoint gutters.
behavior.frames: When equal columns overlap original right text, write explicit positive per-column widths and compute paragraph indents from the same rounded frame. Preserve page margins and header/footer coordinates.
behavior.flow: Sort only adopted column-body interval by column and source vertical position before assigning flow indices. Unpaired rows do not add repeated column breaks; leading/trailing full-width content remains outside the sort.
behavior.Roman_fallback: Only exact known unembedded NimbusRomNo9L Regu/Medi/ReguItal/MediItal faces, optionally with valid six-uppercase subset prefix, request Times New Roman with matching style. Embedded face/program metadata and unknown names remain unchanged; mixed table styles stay distinct.
behavior.policies_unchanged: No dependencies, public API/config/CLI changes, source/gold edits, Unicode overrides, font program/permission changes, strict/OCR bypass or new tracked PDF fixtures.
